Both required suites pass, and a full `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean too.

## Summary

Renumbered `Status` so `cited` sorts before `derived`, without breaking the wire format:

- **`crates/smysl-core/src/types/epistemics.rs`**: kept the `as_u8`/`from_u8` wire discriminants exactly as they were (`Derived = 3`, `Cited = 4` — pinned per §2.2, shared with python/go/nodejs and every existing content-addressed uid/fixture), and introduced a separate `Status::rank()` used by a hand-written `Ord`/`PartialOrd` impl so that in-memory comparisons (rule M, rule T, `Status::ALL` order) now treat `cited` as weaker than `derived`. Updated/split the discriminant test and added an explicit Ord-order test.
- **`crates/smysl-check/src/passes/{epistemics,trust}.rs`** and **`crates/smysl-ingest/src/{ceiling,stage}.rs`**: updated tests whose expectations depended on the old relative strength of `cited` vs. `derived` (e.g. a `derived` claim can no longer rest solely on a `cited` ground; `computed`'s rule-T ceiling now also permits `cited`).
- **`fixtures/schema/unit.json`**: regenerated golden schema fixture (only the `status` enum's listed order changed); verified `smysl-provider`'s Appendix C tests still pass against it.

Since the wire discriminants didn't move, no uids, golden CBOR/render fixtures, or doc-output transcripts needed regenerating. Verified with `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo fmt --check`, both clean, in addition to the two required commands.
